about.title: About me
about.description: I come from a communication design background and want to combine my creative skills with technology. I enjoy understanding how things work and building them myself. I’m curious, analytical and enjoy learning independently while also exchanging ideas with others. When I face a problem, I break it down, try different approaches and find a solution.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

project1.title: Join
project1.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.

project2.title: El Pollo Loco
project2.description: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object oriented approach. Help Pepe find coins and salsa bottles to fight against the evil chicken.

references.title: References
references.description: I thrive both independently and as part of a team. Here’s what my colleagues have to say about working with me.

reference1.name: V. Schuster
reference1.text: Leo really kept the team together with her great organization and clear communication. We wouldn't have got this far without her commitment.

reference2.name: E.Eichinger
reference2.text: Leo was a top team colleague at DA. Her positive commitment and willingness to take on responsibility made a significant contribution to us achieving our goals.

reference3.name: I. Nuber
reference3.text: It was a great pleasure to work with Leo. She knows how to encourage team members to present the best work possible, always adding something to brainstorm.
